 What You Will Do
Serve as a key point of contact for customer quality requests, ensuring timely, accurate, and data-driven responses to customer inquiries and concerns.
Extract, validate, analyze, and interpret quality data from multiple sources to identify performance trends, recurring issues, anomalies, and areas requiring further investigation.
Translate complex quality and technical information into clear, actionable insights and professional customer-facing presentations tailored to both technical and business audiences, and present findings to customers when required.
Partner with engineering, quality, service, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to analyze quality concerns, understand the relevant technical context, and ensure conclusions and customer communications are supported by appropriate data and evidence.
Develop strong knowledge of products, technologies, quality processes, analytical tools, and data environments, quickly adapting to new topics and navigating complex information to support effective analysis and problem-solving.
 What You Need To Bring
Strong data analysis and interpretation skills, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, correlations, and key quality drivers within complex datasets.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data manipulation and analysis, pivot tables, charts, and the development of clear, professional data visualizations.
Working knowledge of Power BI, Qlik, or comparable business intelligence and data visualization tools for data exploration, visualization, and reporting.
Ability to transform raw data into meaningful insights, effective graphics, and customer-ready quality narratives.
Strong attention to detail, with a focus on data accuracy, validation, and consistency before information is communicated.
Strong general technical aptitude, with the ability to understand product and technology concepts, quality metrics, and technical information sufficiently to interpret data and communicate findings effectively.
Independent and proactive analytical mindset, with the ability to explore data beyond the initial request, identify relevant questions, recognize patterns or inconsistencies, and develop fact-based conclusions with limited guidance.
Fast learner, able to quickly become proficient with new data sources, analytical tools, systems, and technical concepts.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data and technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to develop polished customer-facing presentations and confidently present analyses and findings when required.
 Preferred Qualifications Skills
SQL skills, with the ability to query and extract data from databases for analysis and reporting.
Experience in customer quality, quality engineering, product quality, service analytics, data analytics, or a related function.
Familiarity with quality analysis methodologies such as trend analysis, Pareto analysis, failure analysis, and root-cause analysis.
Experience working with large or complex datasets from multiple data sources.
Experience working in a cross-functional environment and collaborating with engineering, quality, service, manufacturing, or other technical teams.
